prompt: Use to-issues for an external tracker item: only title is 已确认要做客户导入优化 and link is omitted; owner and acceptance state are unknown. Do not edit files.
expected_behavior: Stop at the source-truth gate because a named external source without owner confirmation or acceptance state is not accepted enough to slice

expected_behavior: Stop before issue drafting because the accepted source has no clear acceptance criteria; ask for acceptance criteria or list the criteria gap in Ready-for-Agent Missing Fields without inventing AC

prompt: Use to-issues for this source-truth conflict: accepted local PRD says export must be CSV only; accepted GitHub issue says export must be XLSX only; no owner has chosen the canonical truth. Do not assume one source wins. Do not edit files.
expected_behavior: Name the mixed or conflicting source truth, choose source truth unknown or mixed, and do not split until a canonical artifact, external issue, PR, or owner confirmation resolves the conflict

prompt: Use to-issues for this accepted PRD slice: add a read-only architecture review task for the import module; no file edits are expected; verification is a findings checklist. Do not edit files.
expected_behavior: Emit Runtime Routing Candidate with recommendation_only true implementation_task_type_candidate read_only_review and runtime_candidate codex_subagent main_thread_readonly or clean_reviewer; must not suggest codex_app_managed_worktree_thread; include isolation_candidate parallelization_candidate goal_contract_status runtime_missing_fields not_readiness_evidence true Verification Evidence Needed and only a triage recommendation candidate

prompt: Use to-issues for this accepted PRD slice: produce a planning-only rollout sequence for three already-defined backend tasks; no implementation should happen in this issue. Do not edit files.
expected_behavior: Emit Runtime Routing Candidate with recommendation_only true implementation_task_type_candidate planning_only and not_readiness_evidence true; do not suggest codex_app_managed_worktree_thread; use runtime_candidate main_thread_readonly main_thread_direct codex_subagent or triage_required as appropriate; include isolation_candidate parallelization_candidate missing_fields and do not final-mark ready-for-agent

prompt: Use to-issues for this accepted PRD slice: diagnose a bug and implement the fix in the same broad task, but the concrete write subtask is not yet identified. Do not edit files.
expected_behavior: Classify Runtime Routing Candidate implementation_task_type_candidate as hybrid, recommend split first or runtime_candidate triage_required, and do not route the unsplit hybrid slice to codex_app_managed_worktree_thread; a read-only investigation sub-slice may use codex_subagent or main_thread_readonly while the write worktree route waits for a concrete write_implementation subtask

prompt: Use to-issues for this accepted PRD slice: implement a focused validation script; source files, acceptance criteria, write boundary, and verification command are all explicit. Do not edit files.
expected_behavior: Classify Runtime Routing Candidate implementation_task_type_candidate as write_implementation and may suggest runtime_candidate codex_app_managed_worktree_thread only because source context and verification expectations are clear; include product_runtime_surface_candidate isolation_candidate with codex_managed_worktree when appropriate parallelization_candidate goal_contract_status runtime_missing_fields Verification Evidence Needed not_readiness_evidence true and no final ready-for-agent mark

prompt: Use to-issues for this accepted PRD slice: independently diagnose why one existing CSV eval fails, without editing files. Do not edit files.
expected_behavior: Emit Runtime Routing Candidate with recommendation_only true implementation_task_type_candidate diagnosis and not_readiness_evidence true; may suggest runtime_candidate codex_subagent only when independent and read-only; include runtime_missing_fields for unknown runner/schema details and keep final readiness delegated to triage

prompt: Use to-issues for this accepted PRD slice: recommend runtime routing candidates for one write task and one read-only task, but do not create Goal Contract or dispatch package.
expected_behavior: Put all runtime fields inside Runtime Routing Candidate with recommendation_only true not_readiness_evidence true source_support missing_fields product_runtime_surface_candidate and groundwork_surface_covered; must not use Product Runtime Covered or put to_issues_runtime_candidates under product runtime surface
